title.en: The One With the Shop Assistant Job

description.es: Fina y Petra deciden presentarse como candidatas a los puestos de dependienta que han quedado vacantes en la tienda. Fina le confiesa a Petra que Marta la intimida.
description.en: Fina and Petra decide to apply for the shop assistant positions that have become available at the store. Fina admits to Petra that Marta intimidates her.
